newsitem.title: USA: Man convicted of burying newborn baby alive.
newsitem.headline: Man convicted of burying newborn baby alive.

text.p: A 23-year-old man was convicted of murder on Thursday for burying his newborn baby son alive just after his girlfriend gave birth to the child.
The verdict against Billy Stockwell of Watertown, Tennessee, came after a two-day jury trial in Wilson County Criminal Court.
Judge J.O. Bond sentenced Stockwell to life in prison. He would be eligible for parole after serving 33 years.
Prosecutors said the incident occurred in May 1995 when Stockwell's girlfriend, Lisa Murphy, gave birth to the baby in a ramshackle trailer.
Murphy, now 19, testified Wednesday that Stockwell took the baby from her arms and buried the crying child alive in a shallow grave in the dirt floor of a barn.
Murphy, who told the court that she has since married Stockwell and is again pregnant with a child by him, is charged with criminal responsibility for the death and will be tried later.
